about.title: Menifee Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A product that fails in your kitchen, your garage, or on Newport Road during a Friday afternoon drive can change everything in a moment. Across this Riverside County city of roughly 87,000 people, households rely on appliances, power tools, medications, auto components, and children's gear every day, trusting that each one was designed and built with care. When that trust is broken, California law gives you a clear path. Product liability claims here usually rest on strict liability, which means you generally do not need to show the manufacturer was negligent. What matters is that the product carried a defect in its design, its manufacturing, or its warnings, and that the defect caused your injury. Responsibility can extend beyond the maker to the distributor and even the retailer that sold it. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that introduces Menifee residents to an independent attorney who takes these cases on contingency. Hold onto the product, keep any packaging and receipts, and let us make the connection.

items.title: Strict liability works in your favor
items.desc: Under California law, you generally only have to show the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury. The attorney we connect you with understands how to frame design, manufacturing, and warning defects so the burden stays where the law places it.

items.title: Every link in the chain can be accountable
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers may all share responsibility for a defective product. An independent attorney can identify each party rather than letting one point fingers at another.

items.title: Preserving the product is step one
items.desc: The item that hurt you is the centerpiece of the claim, and an attorney will want it kept exactly as it is. We move quickly so that evidence is protected before anything is discarded or repaired.

items.question: A part on my car failed while I was driving on Scott Road in Menifee. Is that a product liability claim or a car accident claim?
items.answer: It may be both, and that is exactly the kind of question an attorney sorts out early. Menifee recorded 312 injury collisions in 2025, and while most are driver-related, some involve a component that did not perform as designed. If a defect in the brakes, tires, steering, or airbag contributed to the crash, the manufacturer or seller of that part may be liable in addition to any at-fault driver. Do not have the vehicle repaired or scrapped until an attorney has reviewed it.

items.question: Do I have to prove the company knew the product was unsafe?
items.answer: Usually not. California product liability claims typically proceed under strict liability, so the focus is on whether the product had a defect in design, manufacturing, or warnings and whether that defect caused your injury. Proving what the company knew or intended is generally not required. That said, evidence of prior complaints or recalls can still strengthen a claim.
